transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose what brings me in is that I just keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn't wake up. It's... it's just been on my mind a lot. And lately, I've been saying that I really don't need to see another winter. So, they wanted me to come talk to you.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things the way you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yes, I have. I used to really look forward to things... playing bridge, working out in the garden, the church cooking, going to Cubs games. But now, I just sit in my chair. I just can't make myself care about any of it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been a while now. I'd say this has been going on since my bowling partner died. That was about a year and a month ago.
Have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or ending your life?

Well, like I was saying when I first came in... I just keep having those thoughts that my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn't wake up tomorrow. I don't know if I have a specific plan to do something, but... I meant it when I told them I don't need to see another winter. I just wouldn't mind if it all ended.
Have you made any specific plans or preparations for ending your life?

No, no specific plans or preparations. Like I was just saying, it's mostly just... I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn't wake up. I haven't gone out and set anything up or bought anything. I've just been telling everyone I don't need to see another winter, and I mean that, but... no, I haven't made any actual plans to make it happen.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the time, even on a daily basis?
Yeah... yes, I do. It's pretty much every single day. I just... I feel low all the time now. There really aren't any good days anymore, just that same heavy feeling.
Have you ever experienced times when your mood was unusually high or you felt an unusually increased amount of energy, even for a short period of time?

No, I've never had anything like that. I've never felt unusually high or had a bunch of extra energy. It's just been... well, just feeling down and tired all the time. I don't think I've ever had a time where I felt the way you're describing.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, before this current time?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I felt a little blue, you know, just normal life stuff... but nothing like this. This is the first time it's ever been this bad or lasted this long. I've never had a period like this before.
Have you ever had an episode in your life where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than just a few days, even if it wasn't as bad or as long as this current time?
No, not really. I mean, like I said, I've had normal days where I felt a little sad, but... no, nothing that lasted more than a day or two. Never anything like this.
